error.message: E-KB-HTTP-UNREACHABLE: POST /api/kb/feedback: the KB server at http://127.0.0.1:0 is unreachable (<cause>); the operation was queued offline and is sent once the server answers again, and no local store or bible is used instead. Remediation: start the KB server or restore the network path to it, or use a local SQLite KB (kb_setup provider sqlite).
